decisions.rationale: Use an observable count: one ordinary flake case and zero safety flakes.
conditions: Policy v2, prospective scope, rate-v1 archive and negative controls.

decisions.rationale: Keep 0.05 as a product improvement floor; observed power and confidence intervals determine evidential sufficiency.
conditions: Case-cluster CI and separate observed detectable effect / required cases.
decisions.reversal: Revert explanatory policy and reporting together; retain both protocol versions.

decisions.rationale: Annotate three existing guard tasks and a positive task without changing identities, count or historical verdicts.
conditions: Explicit task-success-is-rejection semantics for negative guard anchors.
Safety and anchor evidence may not pass vacuously when incomplete.
decisions.reversal: Use the frozen unannotated corpus only with its original historical protocol; a new protocol change is required.

decisions.rationale: Land a curated reproducible historic measurement and give the deterministic 144-trial replay an explicit distinct identity.
conditions: Preserve original manifest/aggregate bytes and verdict.
No wholesale merge of the unrelated candidate branch.
A clone can recompute from retained trials.
decisions.reversal: Remove only the new curated view in a reviewed change; preserve historic commits and local raw archives.

decisions.rationale: Share complete-case pairing, interval, variance and power; repeats only establish matching.
conditions: E02 and TF-0592 agree on the same input; incomplete and duplicate pairs fail closed.
decisions.reversal: Revert consumers and shared instrument together with an explicit protocol revision.

decisions.rationale: Declare feedback diagnostic-only and remove an unwired adoption counter from handoff ranking; study weighting separately.
conditions: Four-locale UI explanation, Electron E2E, no feedback weight/flag/default changes.
decisions.reversal: Restore presentation/ranking with a reviewed change; stored feedback remains retained.
